_note: Reviewer corrections applied on every run. Key = 'wo:<work order #>' or '<site code>@<start YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM Central>'. Fields: category, reason, note (shown on the page), minutes (sets the up time to start + minutes). 'added' = events missing from MaintainX: {site, start, minutes, category, reason}. 'districts' = site code -> district for sites missing from MaintainX teams; 'closed_sites' = codes left out of site counts. 'managers' = district -> manager name, overriding MaintainX team names.
